inj.note: McCormick dislocated his ankle during the Steelers' 38-18 loss to the Bengals on Sunday. The good news for the third-year pro is that he avoided a fracture and does not require surgery, so there's a chance he could return for the Steelers should the team qualify for the playoffs, per reporters. Brock Hoffman figures to start at left guard in McCormick's stead.

news.h: Sources: Mason McCormick avoided ankle fracture; Steelers place guard on IR
news.d: Steelers guard Mason McCormick, who has been placed on injured reserve, does not need surgery after he was carted off the field with an ankle injury.

news.h: Steelers rally around Mason McCormick after guard suffers gruesome injury
news.d: The Steelers' thoughts were with Mason McCormick after the guard suffered what appeared to be a serious ankle injury and was carted off the field Sunday night.
